TestConfig.StartingText: <?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?> <ns1:SQLXML xmlns:ns1="http://pilotfish.sqlxml"> <ns1:Execute as="recent_admit" into="recent_admits"> <ns1:SQL>SELECT "A01" as 'HL7Type', "OFFENDERS"."ALIAS_NAME_TYPE", "OFFENDERS"."ROOT_OFFENDER_ID" , "OFFENDERS"."LAST_NAME", "OFFENDERS"."FIRST_NAME", "OFFENDERS"."MIDDLE_NAME", "OFFENDERS"."BIRTH_DATE", "OFFENDERS"."SEX_CODE", "OFFENDERS"."RACE_CODE", "OFFENDER_BOOKINGS"."OFFENDER_BOOK_ID", "OFFENDER_BOOKINGS"."BOOK_START_DATE", "LIVING_UNITS"."Description" As "LivUnitBedLoc", "LIVING_UNITS"."AGY_LOC_ID", "OFFENDER_BOOKINGS"."ACTIVE_FLAG" FROM "OMS_OWNER"."OFFENDERS" "OFFENDERS" LEFT OUTER JOIN "OMS_OWNER"."OFFENDER_BOOKINGS" "OFFENDER_BOOKINGS" ON "OFFENDERS"."ROOT_OFFENDER_ID"="OFFENDER_BOOKINGS"."ROOT_OFFENDER_ID" LEFT OUTER JOIN "OMS_OWNER"."LIVING_UNITS" "LIVING_UNITS" ON "OFFENDER_BOOKINGS"."LIVING_UNIT_ID"="LIVING_UNITS"."LIVING_UNIT_ID" WHERE "OFFENDER_BOOKINGS"."BOOKING_END_DATE" IS NULL AND "OFFENDERS"."ALIAS_NAME_TYPE"='G' AND "OFFENDER_BOOKINGS"."ACTIVE_FLAG"='Y' AND ("LIVING_UNITS"."AGY_LOC_ID"= 'DWCRC' OR "LIVING_UNITS"."AGY_LOC_ID"= 'JRCC' OR "LIVING_UNITS"."AGY_LOC_ID"= 'DWCRC' OR "LIVING_UNITS"."AGY_LOC_ID"= 'MRCC' OR "LIVING_UNITS"."AGY_LOC_ID"= 'NDSP') </ns1:SQL> </ns1:Execute> <ns1:XMLOut output="xml" var="recent_events" /> </ns1:SQLXML>
